findings.cause: Public sanitization treated the task-scoped user:description citation as a missing source row, cleared one valid quote and retained the original reportHash. The persisted report itself was intact.
findings.fix: Authorize individual exact citations in a canonical active task report only when captured description/objective, current user text, version, offsets and quote match; require a readable artifact owned by that task. All other references and blocked ancestors retain existing redaction. Never recompute reportHash.
findings.result: Full, summary, stateView, export and uiExport each equal the original raw report and validate its original hash. The unchanged title observer validates the new projection. Historical metrics remain unchanged.

findings.cause: Historical records contain no persisted F04 acceptance. User reported completing it, but no historical window/task/IPC trace proves where the click arrived. A normal isolated replay and injected failure boundaries do not reproduce a product defect.
findings.result: Actual React App and Assistant backend pass click, command response, journal/snapshot/history binding and restart. Test bridge replaces native Electron IPC; native historical cause remains unknown.
